note: Machine-resolved taxonomic records, one per object, produced by scripts/taxa.mjs and NOT hand-edited — a re-run overwrites this file. It exists so §6's external links can be built without a runtime dependency on WoRMS or GBIF. `resolved: false` is a real answer and the app must render it as one: the reasons are the homonyms, the misspellings and the three objects with no animal to look up, all of which §6 names. Hand-curated further reading lives in src/data/elsewhere.json instead, which this file never touches.
